title: Merlin: a computed tomography vision-language foundation model and dataset

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Merlin: a computed tomography vision-language foundation model and dataset》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The large volume of abdominal computed tomography (CT) scans1,2 coupled with the shortage of radiologists3-6 have intensified the need for automated medical image analysis tools.

evidence.text: The large volume of abdominal computed tomography (CT) scans1,2 coupled with the shortage of radiologists3-6 have intensified the need for automated medical image analysis tools.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Merlin: a computed tomography vision-language foundation model and dataset》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】We trained Merlin using a high-quality clinical dataset of paired CT scans (>6 million images from 15,331 CT scans), diagnosis codes (>1.8 million codes) and radiology reports (>6 million tokens).

【Abstract · abstract-1-13】We also computed scaling laws and conducted ablation studies to identify optimal training strategies.

evidence.text: We trained Merlin using a high-quality clinical dataset of paired CT scans (>6 million images from 15,331 CT scans), diagnosis codes (>1.8 million codes) and radiology reports (>6 million tokens).
We also computed scaling laws and conducted ablation studies to identify optimal training strategies.
